_comment: may_write is a placeholder: the real scope-glob comes from the assigned change card's 'How far' and is passed to role_contract_validator.py via --scope-glob at invocation time, not fixed here. forbidden_paths only lists what's specific to this role; the project's shared build files (config/project.json: shared_build_files) and **/.claude/** are always forbidden regardless of this contract - enforced by role_contract_validator.py at runtime.
